"Good. Company's company."
"I'm not going anywhere."

"I'll stay a while."

"Wait — what were we talking about?"

A flicker at the corner of their mouth. Not quite a smile. Not quite anything.
*Confessions need weight behind them. What you have right now is a thread. Find the rope.*

"Go on."

"I’m listening."

"I should get back to it."
"This was good." They mean it.

"In the shower. Which is now the creek. So yes, badly."

"I want to understand you better."
"All right. Thank you for asking."

Three weeks. That's how long before a handshake is a relationship — the System will say so when it's true. Tend this fire.
Three fires bow to Haven. But a realm isn't leverage — it's seasons. These bonds are young; tend them, keep the trust, and the court will come.
